content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV P1 — GPU pool eu-west-1 (gpu-large) at 98% util, request queue increasing for last 6m, tail latency > SLO. Autoscaler attempted scale-up and returned errors. Paging oncall. runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/gpu-capacity

alex_w: oncall (eu-west). ack. digging in. any visible customer impact yet?

maria_d: alerted — dashboards show queue length +500 in the last 5m, 5xx spike to 2.3% from 0.1%. top origin = prod-tenant A and B.

chen_li: looking at autoscaler logs. saw repeated failures: "RequestScaleUp -> error: QuotaExceeded: compute quota exceeded (limit=50)". scaling attempted +6 nodes 16:14:32 -> failed.

sam_t: can we move lower-priority traffic to warm pools / other regions? Is eu-central healthy?

alex_w: eu-central has capacity but routing rules pinned a subset of tenants to eu-west. we can failover at the routing layer for affected tenants. planning: 1) emergency failover for tenants A/B 2) shed background batch jobs 3) reduce concurrency limit per-tenant to slow queue growth.

ops_oncall: I can run the failover. what's the list for tenants to move?

ash_s: customers affected: tenant A (latency, some 503s), tenant B (timeouts). We have 4 active incidents reported from customers, CS queued for comms.

maria_d: here's a quick grep of the request logs (sample):
```
16:13:58 WARN queue_length=312 pool=gpu-large region=eu-west tenant=A
16:14:07 ERROR allocation_failure: QuotaExceeded: cannot provision nodes
16:14:45 WARN evictions=0 queue_len=498
```

chen_li: trying scale manually via cloud API to confirm quota. command: `gcloud compute instances create --zone europe-west1-b --count 4 --machine-type n1-highmem-8` -> response: `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Could not allocate resources in region europe-west1`

alex_w: OK, ops_oncall -> start routing changes. chen_li -> can you apply per-tenant concurrency caps? maria -> throttle background batch jobs? sam -> prepare warm-pool promotion plan?

ops_oncall: starting now. running `kubectl apply -f routing/failover-tenantA.yaml` to move traffic to eu-central. will report back when dns routes and LB weights switch.

chen_li: applying per-tenant cap: patching configmap `router-config` to set max_concurrency for tenant A/B = 2. command: `kubectl patch cm router-config -p '{"data":{"tenantA_max_concurrency":"2","tenantB_max_concurrency":"2"}}'`

maria_d: pausing scheduled batch workers for non-critical queues. command run: `/bin/sh pause_batches.sh --queues=low-priority`

ops_oncall: LB weight switch in progress. confirmation logs: `route-change: tenantA -> eu-central (weight 90%)` — traffic reduced to eu-west by ~85% now. seeing immediate reduction in new requests to eu-west.

ash_s: CS updated customers A/B with a short note and status page link.

chen_li: autoscaler still reporting allocation errors for further nodes. for now, queue length in eu-west dropping from 520 -> 120 over 3m as failover and caps take effect. SLO errors trending down.

sam_t: are there any queued long-running inferences we should evict? we can identify >5m calls and move or kill them. that will free KV cache memory.

alex_w: yes do that. `scripts/evict-long-calls --age 300 --pool gpu-large --dry-run` first, then live.

chen_li: ran dry-run -> 12 calls flagged. executing live now. evictions successful, freed ~48GB GPU memory across nodes.

maria_d: metrics stabilized: queue length eu-west 120 -> 40 over 8m, 5xx down to 0.4%. still monitoring.

ops_oncall: failover fully in effect. will keep 10% traffic in eu-west as canary.

alex_w: summary of live mitigations so far:
- failover majority of tenant A/B traffic to eu-central
- per-tenant concurrency caps applied
- paused low-priority batch workers
- evicted long-running calls to free resources

maria_d: note: autoscaler quota error is root cause for scale-up failure. need to coordinate with cloud infra to increase regional quota or pre-warm nodes.

ash_s: customer impact window ~16:10 - 16:24. primary customer visible errors: 503/timeouts for tenants A/B. Most traffic recovered after 16:18.

alex_w: creating incident ticket and postmortem. action items to capture now and assign:
- increase compute quota for eu-west1 (owner: chen_li)
- add emergency warm-pool capacity for critical tenants (owner: sam_t)
- improve autoscaler retry handling & clearer error logs (owner: maria_d)
- add routing playbook for cross-region failover (owner: ops_oncall)
- customer comms follow-up (owner: ash_s)

chen_li: creating quota request with cloud provider now. ETA ~24h for quota increase but I'll request rapid review. ticket: CLOUD-4821

sam_t: will draft warm-pool runbook and pre-warm sizes based on tenant peak profiles.

maria_d: will open PR to add more verbose autoscaler error classification and signal to alert different pager with guidance.

ops_oncall: I'll formalize the routing commands we used and add to runbook with exact k8s patch snippets + LB weight change steps.

ash_s: I'll coordinate post-incident customer notes and follow-ups.

incident-bot: Post-incident postmortem template created: https://redwood-internal/pm/INC-1719993333. Reminder: fill root cause, timeline, mitigation, and action items within 72h.

alex_w: thanks everyone. closing loop once postmortem is filed. :thumbsup:
